table.purpose: Core catalog of audiovisual titles (movies/TV episodes): each row is one title with its name, plot, genres, year, cast/crew references, category tags, boolean flags, and UUIDs used as cross-table keys. Text values appear obfuscated by a letter-substitution cipher, so literal strings are unreadable, but structure (plot synopses, image URLs, year, genre lists) is clear. Linked tables t02/t03/t04/t06 hold related entities (people/credits, lookup codes).

col_001.name: row_id
col_001.description: Auto-incrementing integer primary key for this table (1..56832, unique, no nulls).

col_002.name: group_name
col_002.description: Short name (991 distinct, each repeated up to ~1100 rows). Likely the name of a grouping entity such as a series/franchise or a common person name shared by many titles; the exact entity is not decidable from values.

col_004.name: genres
col_004.description: Comma-separated genre tags from a small closed set (9 distinct values/combinations, e.g. single tags and 2-3 tag combos).

col_005.name: primary_type
col_005.description: Single-valued attribute with 5 levels, one dominant (~87%). Could be a primary language, country, or title type; the dominant-vs-rare distribution fits a main type/medium code but the exact meaning is not decidable.

col_006.name: external_id_a
col_006.description: Sparse (~49% null) unique integer ID in range 39000-241899 that joins one-to-one to keys in t02 and t03; an external identifier for the title in another dataset.

col_007.name: external_id_b
col_007.description: Sparse (~24% null) unique integer ID (10000-241662) joining one-to-one to t02/t03 primary keys; a second external identifier.

col_008.name: cast_codes_a
col_008.description: Comma-separated single letters from set {F,Y,M,P,I,...} (31 distinct combos). Same letter vocabulary as col_009/010/041, which look like encoded cast lists ({7}{I} patterns); likely an encoded cast/credit list, but the encoding is not decipherable.

col_010.name: cast_codes_b
col_010.description: Another comma-separated letter-code list from the same {F,Y,M,P,I} vocabulary as col_008; likely an alternate encoded cast/credit field.

col_011.name: small_count
col_011.description: Small non-negative integer, mostly 0-14 with one outlier of 1000000 (likely a sentinel). Could be season/episode number or a count; not decidable.

col_013.name: related_id
col_013.description: Integer ID (1-20900, ~8% null) referencing t02/t03/t04 primary keys many-to-one; a link to a related entity (e.g., person, credit, or parent record).

col_015.name: organization
col_015.description: Rarely populated proper-name values (607 distinct, e.g. company-like names); plausibly a production company/distributor/award body, but not confirmable.

col_017.name: plot_synopsis
col_017.description: Long free-text plot summaries/synopses of the title (sentences about characters and stories), ~46% populated.

col_018.name: keywords
col_018.description: Rarely populated comma-separated keyword/tag list from a small vocabulary (36 distinct), e.g. theme tags.

col_019.name: release_year
col_019.description: Year of release: values 1993, 1997, 2003, 2015 plus literal 'future' for unreleased titles.

col_036.name: region_list
col_036.description: Comma-separated values from a name-like vocabulary (1157 distinct, top values repeated hundreds of times); plausibly countries or languages of release, but not confirmable.

col_037.name: status_code
col_037.description: Single code from a 15-value closed set, one dominant value (97%). Likely a status/type/release-state code; exact meanings unknown.

col_038.name: feature_flags_json
col_038.description: JSON object with three boolean-like keys (true/false values); a rarely populated set of feature flags for the title. Key meanings undecipherable.

col_041.name: encoded_cast_list
col_041.description: Structured pattern like '{7}{I}' / '{2}{Y}{Y}{M}{M}' combining numbers with the same letter codes as col_008/010; an encoded cast/credit list (number + person code).

col_042.name: ref_id_1
col_042.description: Large integer ID (up to 535593) referencing t03 primary key many-to-one; a foreign key to a related record (e.g., person/credit).

col_043.name: ref_id_2
col_043.description: Integer ID referencing t03/t02 primary keys many-to-one; another foreign key to a related record.

col_044.name: ref_id_3
col_044.description: Sparse integer ID (mostly 66000-77000 range) referencing t04 primary key; a foreign key to a t04 entity.

col_045.name: uuid_a
col_045.description: Unique UUID-like string, one per row; an alternate unique identifier for the title.

col_046.name: ref_id_4
col_046.description: Sparse integer ID (303-70586) referencing t02/t03/t04 keys many-to-one; a foreign key to a related record.

col_047.name: ref_id_5
col_047.description: Sparse integer ID (9-87921) referencing t02/t03 keys many-to-one; a foreign key to a related record.

col_048.name: ref_id_6
col_048.description: Sparse large integer ID (1-508409), nearly unique when present; likely another external/reference identifier, but no accepted join.

col_049.name: title
col_049.description: Display title of the work (21738 distinct, name/title-like strings, e.g. 'Uvtaataf Izwwr'); the primary title field.

col_051.name: event_date
col_051.description: Date values (YYYY/M/D) but the inferred range (2049-2077) is inconsistent with the sample years (2006-2021), suggesting a shifted or misparsed date; likely a release/event date. Treat with caution.

col_052.name: notes_rules
col_052.description: Free-text notes/rules, sometimes prefixed with the letter codes from the cast vocabulary ({Y}: ...); appears to be game-like or review rules text attached to the title.

col_053.name: category_a
col_053.description: Category/genre-like labels (2992 distinct, e.g. 'Tauoxao', 'Uhmlwms'), often with a dash-separated qualifier; a categorized label for the title.

col_055.name: count_with_notation
col_055.description: Small count (mostly 1-5) with occasional notation values ('∞', '2+*'); likely a quantity such as a count of items/cast, stored loosely.

col_056.name: code_list
col_056.description: Comma-separated list of short alphanumeric codes drawn from the same vocabulary as col_063 (which joins to lookup table t06); a list of lookup codes attached to the title.

col_057.name: theme_tags
col_057.description: Comma-separated tag list from a 64-value vocabulary (e.g. 'qwktxtauwmo'); theme/attribute tags.

col_058.name: image_links_json
col_058.description: JSON object containing image URLs (keys include a primary link, an alternate link, and a thumbnail); per-title artwork references.

col_059.name: medium_type
col_059.description: Four-level code, dominant 'lhqqha' (='small' in the ciphered text, cf. 'lhqqha yhak' = 'small screen' in plot text) vs 'palhqqha' (='big screen'); likely distinguishes TV/small-screen vs theatrical/big-screen titles.

col_060.name: uuid_b
col_060.description: UUID-like string, ~99% unique; an entity identifier (e.g., a linked record key), target meaning unknown.

col_061.name: uuid_c
col_061.description: UUID-like string, 48% unique with repeats up to 35; an identifier for a shared/parent entity (e.g., series or group key).

col_062.name: uuid_d
col_062.description: UUID-like string, 38% unique with repeats up to ~693; another shared-entity identifier, repeats align with the most common titles/names.

col_063.name: lookup_code
col_063.description: Short alphanumeric code (536 distinct) that joins many-to-one to t06.col_005; a reference to a lookup entry in t06 (e.g., certificate/region/edition code).

col_065.name: name_list
col_065.description: Comma-separated name-like values (1505 distinct, e.g. 'Xpmx', 'Zpqxa,Itexmk'); plausibly countries, languages, or role names; not confirmable.

col_066.name: tag_b
col_066.description: Rarely populated tag from an 8-value vocabulary overlapping col_018 ('Rwfwakxms', 'Uahi'); a secondary tag/keyword field.

col_067.name: ref_id_7
col_067.description: Integer ID (86-232634) referencing t03/t02 keys many-to-one; a foreign key to a related record.

col_068.name: notes_rules_b
col_068.description: Free-text notes/rules, largely overlapping col_052 content (same sentences, plus templated '({O}: Xkk {F}.)' patterns); an alternate/expanded notes field.

col_069.name: count_with_notation_b
col_069.description: Small count (mostly 1-5, up to 99) with notation values ('*+1'); same loose-count pattern as col_055.

col_070.name: category_b
col_070.description: Category labels (2022 distinct) overlapping the col_053 vocabulary, often 'prefix — name' format; a categorized label, more populated than col_053.

col_071.name: primary_category
col_071.description: Single (occasionally comma-separated) category from a 37-value set, dominant 'Lmwxopmw' (43%); the primary category/type of the title.

col_072.name: canonical_uuid
col_072.description: Unique UUID per row, referenced by t02.col_008, t03.col_004 and t04.col_004; the canonical cross-table key for this title.

col_073.name: related_uuid_list
col_073.description: Comma-separated list of UUIDs (mostly single), 96% unique; a list of related entity keys (e.g., linked titles/versions).

table.name: cards
table.purpose: One row per card (per printed face) of a trading-card game (Magic: The Gathering–style). Text fields are stored in many languages (English, German, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Russian), and Latin-script values appear obfuscated/enciphered, but structure (typelines like 'Instant — Arcane', token spawn rules, UUIDs, set-like references) clearly identifies a card/face table.

col_001.name: card_id
col_001.description: Synthetic primary key; unique integer 1..~229k, one per row (card face). Referenced by several columns in t01 and t06.

col_002.name: flavor_text
col_002.description: Flavor text / italic quote on the card. Multilingual free text, often in quotation marks; empty for ~44% of cards (typical for flavor text).

col_003.name: card_type
col_003.description: Coarse card type/category with only 16 distinct values (e.g. values matching counts of Creature/Instant/Sorcery-like categories, one value resembling 'Planeswalker (…)'). Distribution (~30k per value) matches a type classification. Could alternatively be a layout/rarity grouping, but type is the best fit.

col_004.name: multiverseid
col_004.description: Mostly-unique integer in the 73k–508k range, null for ~17% of rows. Pattern fits a printing identifier such as MTG's multiverseid (null for tokens/some digital-only cards). Exact meaning not fully confirmed.

col_005.name: card_name
col_005.description: Card name, stored per language (e.g. Japanese '霊程の振り子', Korean '제스카이 방어벽' = 'Jeskai Wall'). ~70% unique; duplicates come from reprints and shared names.

col_006.name: rules_text
col_006.description: Rules/oracle text of the card, multilingual; includes game mechanics (e.g. token-spawn rules '7/7 white Soldier creature', keyword lines like 'Flying' / '飛行'). Empty for ~16% (basic lands, faces without text).

col_007.name: type_line
col_007.description: Full type line, e.g. 'Instant — Arcane' / 'Legendary Creature — …' patterns; ~16.6k distinct combinations, empty for ~14% of rows.

col_008.name: printing_uuid
col_008.description: UUID (scryfall-style) identifying the card printing; references t01.col_072 many-to-one, linking each card face to its parent printing/set entry in t01.

The exact business meaning cannot be determined from the obfuscated values, but the structure (child of t01, many rows per parent) suggests line items or events associated with t01 records.

col_001.name: id
col_001.description: Surrogate primary key; sequential integer 1..427907 with no nulls, unique across the table. Referenced by many columns in t01 and t06.

col_002.description: A 15-level categorical code (obfuscated strings, roughly uniform frequencies ~55k each). Could be a type, region, or group code; the specific meaning of each value is not recoverable from the data.

col_003.name: status
col_003.description: A 3-value flag dominated by 'Rwfxr' (99.3%), with rare 'Yxaawk' (0.5%) and 'Mwuomtlowk' (0.15%). Reads like a status/state field with one default value and two exceptional states; the actual meanings of the codes are unresolved.

col_004.name: t01_id
col_004.description: UUID-formatted (obfuscated) foreign key referencing t01.col_072; many rows of t03 map to one t01 record (many_to_one). Not unique in t03 (max 15 repeats per value).

table.name: rulings
table.purpose: Likely a notes/comments table: each row is a free-text note (col_003) attached to a parent record in t01 (via col_004) on a given date (col_002). The text appears to be obfuscated/scrambled English (letter-substituted), so exact content is unreadable, but the structure (long sentences, repeated phrases like 'Xkdwaopmw' = 'Management'?) suggests case/incident notes. Marked tentative because the text is encoded and cannot be read directly.

col_001.name: note_id
col_001.description: Primary key; sequential integer 1..87769 uniquely identifying each row (note).

col_002.name: note_date
col_002.description: Date of the note, stored as a string. Range 2060-10-04 to 2077-02-05; the future years suggest synthetic/anonymized data (possibly a shifted real date).

col_003.name: note_text
col_003.description: Body text of the note. Content is character-substituted (obfuscated) English prose, so the actual meaning of the text cannot be verified; it is long free-form narrative text.

col_004.name: parent_record_id
col_004.description: UUID-like identifier (obfuscated characters) referencing a record in t01 (t01.col_072), many notes to one parent record.

col_002.name: category

col_003.name: reference_code
col_003.description: 3-character alphanumeric code (121 distinct, ~10 rows each) referencing t06.col_005 (many-to-one). Likely a foreign key to a lookup/entity table in t06; exact meaning unresolved.

col_004.name: title
col_004.description: Free-text title/name, multilingual (Korean, Russian, Japanese, transliterated text), ~19% null, roughly half unique. Plausibly a product/edition title or localized name; exact meaning unresolved.

table.purpose: Each row appears to be a work item / task / project record: it has a unique ID, a unique short code, a title, a date, several boolean flags, an owner reference (col_002/col_020) into t01/t02/t03, and a status/category field (col_021). The exact domain cannot be confirmed because all text is obfuscated/encrypted, so most columns are only structurally characterized. Note: col_002 and col_020 are near-duplicates (same top values and range), suggesting redundant copies of the same foreign key. col_005 is referenced by t01.col_063 and t05.col_003, so t06 is a lookup/master table for other tables via this code. col_012 (one-to-one into t01/t02/t03) and col_014 (a unique name, same 36.5% fill rate as col_012) look like an optional linked record and its denormalized name. col_004 holds JSON-like structured payloads (obfuscated keys) in ~25% of rows. col_018 is a date (2049-2077, many Jan-1 values, suggesting planned/annual dates). The boolean columns col_006-col_010 are flags with unknown semantics (unresolved). col_021 is a low-cardinality status/category field (20 values, e.g. 'vmhqh' dominant). Text values appear to be encoded (possibly a substitution cipher), so exact meanings of names, titles and statuses cannot be recovered from the evidence alone.

col_001.name: id
col_001.description: Primary key; sequential integer 1-551, one per row.

col_002.name: owner_id
col_002.description: Foreign key referencing t01/t02/t03 primary keys (many-to-one). Duplicated by col_020 (same top values and range). Likely the person/team/department this record belongs to.

col_004.name: details_json
col_004.description: JSON-formatted structured payload (obfuscated keys, nested objects with numeric fields), present in ~25% of rows. Looks like a serialized detail/configuration blob; exact schema unknown.

col_005.name: code
col_005.description: Unique short alphanumeric code per row (e.g. 'R78', 'VFMA'). Referenced by t01.col_063 and t05.col_003, so it acts as the external business key/identifier of this record used by other tables.

col_011.name: type_code
col_011.description: Short code with a few dominant values (VQWT, KWBXPRO, KLT, VXMR) covering most rows plus a long tail; looks like a type/classification code. Exact meanings are obfuscated.

col_012.name: linked_record_id
col_012.description: Optional integer, one-to-one join to t01/t02/t03 primary keys, filled in ~36% of rows. Appears to reference a specific record in another table; its display name is likely denormalized in col_014 (identical null rate and uniqueness).

col_014.name: linked_record_name
col_014.description: Unique name-like text filled in the same ~36% of rows as col_012; likely the denormalized name of the record referenced by col_012. Text is obfuscated.

col_016.name: title
col_016.description: Unique non-null title/name of the record (e.g. 'Qxftl Vrxswm Mwixmku 2447'); often combines a name with a year-like number. Text is obfuscated.

col_018.name: date
col_018.description: Non-null date between 2049 and 2077, with many January-1 values, suggesting a planned/target date (possibly fiscal-year or start date). Exact semantic (start vs due date) is unclear.

col_019.name: secondary_ref_id
col_019.description: Optional integer referencing t02/t03/t04 primary keys (many-to-one), ~47% fill, with one dominant value 62 (21 rows). Likely a second foreign key to a different entity than col_002/col_020.

col_020.name: owner_id_copy
col_020.description: Near-duplicate of col_002: same top values, range and joins into t01/t02/t03. Likely a redundant copy of the same owner foreign key (possibly a corrected/updated version).

col_021.name: status
col_021.description: Non-null low-cardinality field with 20 values, dominated by 'vmhqh' (234 rows) followed by 'wcvxautha', 'qwqhmxytrtx', 'yhc', 'kpwr_kwlj'. Clearly a status/category field; the values are obfuscated so individual statuses cannot be decoded.
